newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR NOVEMBER 16-18.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR NOVEMBER 16-18.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for period November 16-18:
Saturday, Nov 16:
English F.A. Cup first round - Ashford Town v Dagenham and
Redbridge, Blackpool v Wigan, Boreham Wood v Rushden and
Diamonds, Boston United v Morecambe, Brentford v Bournemouth,
Bristol Rovers v Exeter, Bromley v Enfield, Burnley v Lincoln,
Cambridge United v Welling, Cardiff v Hendon, Carlisle v
Shepshed Dynamo, Chester v Stalybridge, Chesterfield v Bury,
Colchester v Wycombe, Colwyn Bay v Wrexham, Crewe v
Kidderminster, Farnborough v Barnet, Gillingham v Hereford,
Hartlepool v York, Hednesford v Southport, Leyton Orient v
Merthyr, Macclesfield v Rochdale, Mansfield v Consett, Northwich
v Walsall, Peterborough v Cheltenham, Plymouth v Fulham, Preston
v Altrincham, Runcorn v Darlington, Scunthorpe v Rotherham,
Shrewsbury v Scarborough, Stevenage v Hayes, Stockport v
Doncaster, Sudbury Town v Brighton, Swansea v Bristol City,
Torquay v Luton, Wisbech v St Albans.
English Premier league - Aston Villa v Leicester, Blackburn
v Chelsea, Everton v Southampton, Leeds v Liverpool, Manchester
United v Arsenal, Newcastle v West Ham, Tottenham v Sunderland,
Wimbledon v Coventry.
English Division one - Bolton v Crystal Palace, Bradford v
Ipswich, Grimsby v Stoke, Norwich v Reading, Oxford v
Huddersfield, Port Vale v Sheffield United, Portsmouth v
Manchester City, Queens Park Rangers v Charlton, Southend v West
Bromwich, Swindon v Barnsley.
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Dundee United, Hearts
v Hibernian, Kilmarnock v Motherwell, Raith v Dunfermline.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v Falkirk, Clydebank v
Partick, Dundee v St Johnstone, St Mirren v Greenock Morton,
Stirling v East Fife.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Livingston, Brechin v
Clyde, Queen of the South v Hamilton, Stenhousemuir v Dumbarton,
Stranraer v Ayr.
Scottish division three - Albion v Queen's Park, Cowdenbeath
v Arbroath, East Stirling v Alloa, Forfar v Montrose, Inverness
C. Thistle v Ross County.
Sunday, November 17:
English F.A. Cup first round - Newcastle Town v Notts
County, Northampton v Watford, Whitby Town v Hull.
English Premier league - Derby v Middlesbrough.
English Division one - Wolverhampton v Birmingham.
Monday, November 18:
English Premier league - Sheffield Wednesday v Nottingham
Forest.
